Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

- (c) If the Grade Pay of the employee in the parent cadre becomes higher than that of the deputation post on getting financial upgradation under the ACP / MACP Scheme, the employee may be allowed to draw the pay in the Pay Band plus Grade Pay to which he becomes entitled to under the ACP / MACPS, if opted for by him, as laid down in Para. 27 of Annexure I to the DoP&T, O.M. No. 35034/3/2008-Estt. (D), dated the 19th May, 2009.
